sources.snippet: We curate open-source neural data with standardized preprocessing and stimulus alignment, then tokenize them via Brainμ, delivering AI-ready neural data for plug-and-play model training.

sources.title: GitHub - BAAI-Brain-Inspired-Group/Brainmu
sources.snippet: Brainmu0 is a general-purpose foundation model framework for modeling brain activity across neural recording modalities. It is designed to provide a unified representation space for diverse neural signals, including EEG, calcium imaging, and in vivo electrophysiology. sources.title: Brain-inspired Artificial Intelligence: A Comprehensive Review
sources.snippet: This comprehensive review explores the diverse design inspirations that have shaped modern AI models, i.e., brain-inspired artificial intelligence (BIAI). We present a classification framework that categorizes BIAI approaches into physical structure-inspired and human behavior-inspired models.
